title: The Instagrammable Bali | Couple Special
highlights: Discover Bali, from Kuta’s beaches and vibrant nightlife to Ubud’s traditional art, crafts, and lush landscapes.
Marvel at the panoramic views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur from the scenic Kintamani Highlands, a region renowned for its dramatic volcanic landscape.
Snap stunning photos at the iconic Handara Gate, a picturesque Balinese entrance framed by lush greenery and set against a mountainous backdrop.
Indulge in a luxurious Balinese spa experience, where traditional treatments and serene settings provide ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation.
Discover the natural wonders of Nusa Penida Island, including breathtaking coastal cliffs, crystal-clear waters, and pristine beaches that showcase Bali’s tropical beauty.
overview:
About the Tour:
Dotted with alluring beaches, a serene coastline, temples, lush green rice terraces, charming waterfalls, and more, Bali is the ideal destination to spend quality time with your loved ones. Stroll around the beautiful beach of Kuta, known for its unique charm and party-centric atmosphere that attracts travellers from all over the world. Satiate the adventurer in you by embarking on a thrilling jungle safari, or spend a romantic evening watching the sunset over the pristine waters of the Indian Ocean.

Meals not mentioned are not included in the package.
Personal expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will have to be paid by you at the destination.
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
Please do not litter and keep the environment clean.

Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange the itinerary due to any kind of disturbance that occurred (i.e weather condition, political condition or any others) without changing the total number of days and without compromising any service.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance at your own cost.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
The hotels are subject to availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel in Ubud. Check in and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can explore Ubud on your own, with highlights including the serene Bali Park and the intriguing Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave). If time allows, experience the fun and excitement at Waterbom Waterpark. Later, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for Central Bali sigtseeing tour. Discover the Kintamani Highlands, offering stunning views of the active Mount Batur and its volcanic lake. Also, see the Tegallalang Rice Terraces showcasing Bali’s traditional rice cultivation with their intricate, verdant layers. Capture the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall and and take a thrilling ride on the Bali Swing, gliding high above the lush jungle. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour with Tanah Lot Temple
days.desc: Begin your day by getting transferred to visit Bali’s iconic Handara Gate, renowned for its grand, intricately carved entrance an iconic landmark known for its intricate Balinese design and lush backdrop, often considered as the most photographed spots in Bali. Also, visit the sacred Ulun Danu Temple, located by Lake Beratan. Conclude at Tanah Lot Temple, perched on a volcanic rock formation, renowned for its stunning ocean sunsets. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Bali Safari and Marine Park
days.desc: Today, you’ll be transferred to Bali Safari and Marine Park, home to over 1,000 exotic animals. Encounter the unique Binturong, often called a bearcat, with its fox-like face and monkey-like tail. Experience a tram safari through the park, explore the fascinating freshwater aquarium, and enjoy engaging animal presentations. Watch the captivating Bali Agung Show and cool off at the Water Play Zone with its fun water rides. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Excursion to Nusa Penida Island
days.desc: Today, check out and board the transfer to your hotel in Kuta. After checking in, you'll be driven to Sanur Harbor for a shared speedboat ride to Nusa Penida Island. Explore the stunning Kelingking Beach with its dramatic cliff formations, and marvel at Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool. Take a stroll along Bubu Beach and see the striking Broken Bay. After a day of island exploration, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
